details: 1. Veins and Lodes: Cracks and fissures in Igneous/Metamorphic rocks (Tin, Copper, Zinc, Lead).
2. Beds and Layers: Accumulation in Sedimentary rock strata (Coal, Iron Ore, Gypsum).
3. Residual Mass: Weathering of surface rocks leaving residual material (Bauxite).
4. Placer Deposits: Alluvial deposits in valley floor sands, non-corrosive (Gold, Silver, Platinum).
5. Ocean Waters & Beds: Soluble salts and seabed deposits (Common salt, Magnesium, Manganese nodules).
evidence_or_examples: Khetri copper mines in Rajasthan (lodes); Monazite sands in Kerala (placer).

details: Iron Ore: Magnetite (70% iron, high magnetic quality), Hematite (50-60% iron, major industrial ore). Major belts: Odisha-Jharkhand, Durg-Bastar-Chandrapur, Ballari-Chitradurga-Chikkamagaluru-Tumakuru, Maharashtra-Goa.
Manganese: Essential for steel manufacturing (10 kg manganese per ton of steel); Odisha top producer.
Bauxite: Aluminum ore; lightweight, high conductivity, malleable; Panchpatmali deposits in Koraput, Odisha.
Copper: Malleable, ductile, good conductor; Balaghat mines (MP), Khetri (Rajasthan), Singhbhum (Jharkhand).
Mica: Excellent di-electric strength, low power loss factor, insulating; Koderma-Gaya-Hazaribagh belt (Jharkhand).
evidence_or_examples: Kudremukh iron ore slurry pipeline to Mangaluru port; Balaghat copper mines producing 52% of India's copper.

details: Coal: Gondwana coal (200 million years old, metallurgical coking coal) and Tertiary coal (55 million years old, NE states). Varieties: Anthracite, Bituminous, Lignite, Peat.
Petroleum: Trapped in anticlines and fault traps; Mumbai High, Ankleshwar (Gujarat), Digboi (Assam - oldest oilfield).
Natural Gas: Environmentally friendly fuel; HVJ (Hazira-Vijaipur-Jagdishpur) cross-country pipeline.
Non-Conventional: Solar (Rajasthan/Gujarat), Wind (Nagarcoil to Madurai in TN), Biogas (Gobar gas plants), Tidal (Gulf of Khambhat), Geothermal (Manikaran in HP, Puga Valley in Ladakh).
evidence_or_examples: Digboi as India's oldest operating oilfield; HVJ pipeline transporting gas over 1,700 km.
